title.en: A mirror is not a backup

concept.hr: RAID štiti od kvara diska, ne od brisanja ni pogrešnog sadržaja
concept.en: RAID protects against disk loss, not deletion or corruption

summary.hr: Obriši datoteku na zdravom zrcalu: /proc/mdstat i dalje kaže [2/2] [UU], a brisanje je upisano na oba diska. Polje preživi kvar diska, ne brisanje.
summary.en: Delete a file on a healthy mirror: /proc/mdstat still says [2/2] [UU], and the delete was written to both disks. A mirror survives disk loss, not a delete.
